commits.subject: Merge pull request #577 from zen010101/dhcp-domain-name-option15
commits.body: net: DHCP server was never sending the domain-name option 15
commits.author: ab

commits.subject: net: DHCP server was never sending the domain-name option 15
commits.body:
TDhcpState.AddRegularOptions() is documented (twice) as appending the
"1,3,6,15,28,42" regular options, and the DHCP_REQUEST default client
list does ask for option 15, but TDhcpScopeSettings.DomainName was only
used to compute the DDNS FQDN - never written into OFFER/ACK. So the
documented "domain-name" setting silently had no effect, unless
duplicated into a "rule" as "always"/"requested".

Appended after AddRulesOptions() so a "rule" value still has precedence,
and via AddOptionOnceU() as already used for options 66/67, which skips
an unset (nil) value: scopes without a domain-name are unchanged.

Tests: the scope value now shows up in the OFFER, and a "rule" one still
overrides it.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: several DNS fixes
commits.body:
- allow IPv6 server address
- fixed Z flag setting
- reject invalid responses ASAP to continue with the next server
- (I hope) last refactoring and cleaning pass
- we should be pretty much compliant with most DNS requirements including the latest RFC
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: hardened DNS decompression logic
commits.body: - both faster and more contraint against the RFC and any malformed input
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: several DNS fixes
commits.body:
- derivate actual response position from the QName in returned packet
- reject responses with QuestionCount <> 1
- fixed TCP size assessment
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: dns: allow 'ip:port' for DNS servers definitions
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: several fixes to EDNS(0) support
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: implemented EDNS(0) advertised UDP payload size
commits.body:
- as defined by RFC 6891
- allow UDP frames up to 1232 bytes by default
- therefore TCP fallback would not be usually needed
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: optional EDNS(0) support for DnsBuildQuestion()
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: some DNS code simplification
commits.body: - "no TCP" list can use the new TCachedValues thread-safe wrapper
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez
